messages:
nora: Heads-up team  deploying Adaptive-Quant Routing (AQR) + mini-nova-1.5b model to GA on Hosted API today. Lightweight, quant-aware routing for cost-sensitive low-latency use cases. :sparkles:

nora: TL;DR: customers get automatic routing between quantized variants (int8/int4) and a fallback to full-precision instances based on latency and quality policy. This should reduce unit inference cost for many prompt shapes without developer changes.

ben: Nice! Any new wire or header changes we need to be careful about?

rachel: Two operational notes: we add a response header `x-rw-quant-path` that reports which execution path (int8/int4/full) served the request, and a new billing metric `quant_unit_v1`. Both are optional but will show up in logs and billing starting next invoice.

doc-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/aqr-mini-nova-1-5b-ga  contains policy samples, SDK toggles, and migration guidance (includes Node/Python/Go snippets).

ben: Is this compatible with existing model pins? If a customer pins `mini-nova-1.5b@2026-03-01` do we still route?

nora: By default, routing is enabled for unpinned model names. If a customer explicitly pins a model version we honor that exact runtime (no automatic quant swap). We added a per-request flag `runtime.allow_quant_routing=false` to opt-out.

eng-oncall: Rollout plan: canary in us-west-2 for 45m, then eu-west-1 for 2h, then global. Pager if `serve.errors` > 2% or `latency.p95` increases > 15% for 10m. Also watch `quant.inference.quality_regressions` which is a new alert for deviation vs baseline evals.

rachel: Quick smoke curl (existing API key works):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"mini-nova-1.5b","input":"Write a 3-sentence product summary for a photo app."}' | jq .
# check header with httpie: http --headers POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate Authorization:"Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" Content-Type:application/json body:='{"model":"mini-nova-1.5b","input":"hi"}'
```

finance-bot: Billing note: `quant_unit_v1` will appear as a line item next billing cycle. Were offering a 45-day price harmonization window for customers who migrate from older compact models. Finance will email affected customers.

ben: Perf numbers from bench: for conversational prompts (<=512 tokens) int8 path avg p50 is ~12ms lower than full-precision and cost ~28% lower; int4 gives ~42% cheaper but watch rare quality diffs on longer prompts. We configured a conservative quality threshold for default routing.

nora: Action items: docs to publish migration guide (rachel), SDK owners to expose `runtime.allow_quant_routing` toggle (ben), eng to monitor canary (eng-oncall), finance to notify customers (finance-bot).

rachel: I'll post the docs PR in 20m and a short external blog after global rollout.

eng-oncall: Canary update at 2145678970: us-west-2 canary healthy, no quality regressions detected. Proceeding with staged rollout.

nora: Great work everyone  external announcement scheduled in 1h. Ping here if you need escalation or want early access for a customer :rocket:
